name: Azamuki Shigure
source:
The first boy our protagonist meets. He’s a timid but reliable classmate who supports the protagonist from beginning to end. He’s neck-deep into the occult and has a great interest in supernatural phenomena as well as science fiction and horror. When he gets excited, he can’t put the brakes on his enthusiasm and talks nonstop.

‘It’s alright! Whenever you’re having a hard time…you can count on me, okay?’
‘P-Please tell me all the details! In three sentences or less!’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
